name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.pstn.ui.PstnP2PCallAudioActivity
description: During a NetEase Yunxin PSTN one-to-one audio call, this Activity opens the call screen and lets the user answer, reject, mute, switch speaker, or hang up.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from opening or answering PSTN audio calls.
